# Patient RX System v3.0.11

Production-test release with the standardized Project Control menu plus all v3.0.10 security and FortiGate fixes.

## Project Control alignment

- Replaces the legacy compact RX menu with the shared NOC/CORE/ALARM presentation.
- Displays a framed `RX TRACKER PROJECT CONTROL` header with application version and Project Control version `1.1.0`.
- Uses colored Information, Service Control, Configuration/Releases, and Setup/Dependencies sections.
- Aligns two-column actions and uses RX-specific service wording.
- Uses consistent Y/cancel confirmations, colored command success/failure messages, invalid-selection guidance, and press-any-key return behavior.
- Packages `PROJECT-CONTROL.bat`, `scripts/project-control.ps1`, `project-control.json`, and `package.json` together.
- Recognizes the compiled `PatientRXSystem` service and legacy RX service IDs.

## Security hardening and issues fixed

- Enforces CSRF validation for authenticated writes with safe stale-token recovery.
- Keeps navigation, assets, authentication, and API calls on the public FortiGate proxy path.
- Adds staging-only destructive-action confirmation and fail-closed staging token-version validation.
- Hardens workflow/service-date payloads, database/bootstrap quoting, and backup/restore command transport.
- Fixes Call Center claim/save CSRF failures, duplicate login submission, PostgreSQL tool caching, staging isolation, and duplicated Back Office UI markup.
- Preserves Back Office deletion/purge targets, counts, cascades, user, IP, and timestamps in Audit Logs.

## Validation

- Public JavaScript encoding and syntax checks.
- Back Office delete/cascade/audit regression checks.
- PostgreSQL, workflow-date, and 90-day/call-lead regression checks.
- Isolated executable and ZIP validation with no secret environment, dump, SQL, or credential files.
- Packaged Project Control version/menu validation.
- Prior full staging and live FortiGate proxy smoke coverage remains applicable to the unchanged application hardening code.

## Production-test deployment

1. Download `server-update-3.0.11.zip`.
2. Back up the testing production application folder and database.
3. Stop the testing service/application.
4. Extract the ZIP into the testing application folder.
5. Preserve the existing `.env`; do not replace it with `.env.example`.
6. Run `PROJECT-CONTROL.bat version` and confirm RX Tracker `3.0.11` / Project Control `1.1.0`.
7. Start the application and test login, Patient, Call Center, RX, Back Office deletion/auditing, backup status, and FortiGate access with disposable data.

No database migration or data reset is required.
